import argparse
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import datetime

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", str(text).strip().lower()).strip("-")
    return s


def split_genres(genre_str: str):
    parts = [p.strip() for p in str(genre_str).split(",") if str(p).strip() != ""]
    return parts


def parse_gross_to_int(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return np.nan
    s = str(val).strip()
    s = s.replace(",", "")
    try:
        return int(s)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan


ALLOWED_GENRES = {
    "Action", "Adventure", "Animation", "Biography", "Comedy", "Crime", "Drama", "Family",
    "Fantasy", "History", "Horror", "Music", "Musical", "Mystery", "Romance", "Sci-Fi",
    "Sport", "Thriller", "War", "Western"
}

CERT_ALLOWED = {
    "G", "PG", "PG-13", "R", "NC-17", "U", "UA", "A", "12", "12A", "15", "18",
    "Not Rated", "Approved", "Passed", "TV-G", "TV-PG", "TV-14", "TV-MA"
}

KIDS_CERTS = {"G", "U", "PG", "TV-G"}
TEENS_CERTS = {"PG-13", "12", "12A", "UA", "TV-PG", "TV-14", "15", "Approved", "Passed"}
ADULTS_CERTS = {"R", "A", "NC-17", "18", "TV-MA", "Not Rated"}


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

# Pair uniqueness and title-year consistency before creating identifiers
# ASSERTION_START
pair_unique = ~df.duplicated(subset=["Series_Title", "Released_Year"])
assert pair_unique.all()
by_title = df.groupby("Series_Title")["Released_Year"].agg(["size", "nunique"]).reset_index(drop=True)
assert (by_title["size"] == by_title["nunique"]).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Released year assumptions before computing recency
# ASSERTION_START
years = pd.to_numeric(df["Released_Year"], errors="coerce")
assert years.notna().all()
assert years.between(1900, 2025).all()
year_str_4 = years.astype(int).astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")
assert year_str_4.all()
# ASSERTION_END

df["Released_Year"] = years.astype(int)
year_span = 2025 - 1900
recency_raw = (df["Released_Year"] - 1900) / year_span
df["recency_norm"] = recency_raw.clip(0, 1)

# Rating checks before scoring
# ASSERTION_START
ratings = pd.to_numeric(df["IMDB_Rating"], errors="coerce")
assert ratings.notna().all()
assert ratings.between(0.0, 10.0).all()
assert np.isclose(ratings * 10, np.round(ratings * 10), atol=1e-8).all()
assert (ratings >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.95
# ASSERTION_END

df["IMDB_Rating"] = ratings.astype(float)
df["rating_norm"] = df["IMDB_Rating"] / 10.0

# Runtime checks and parsing prior to using durations
rt_str = df["Runtime"].astype(str)
# ASSERTION_START
assert rt_str.str.fullmatch(r"\d+\s*min").all()
mins_check = rt_str.str.extract(r"(\d+)")[0].astype(int)
assert mins_check.between(45, 240).all()
assert (mins_check.between(80, 180).mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

df["Runtime_min"] = rt_str.str.extract(r"(\d+)")[0].astype(int)

# Meta_score checks and normalization prior to critic heavy ranking
ms = pd.to_numeric(df["Meta_score"], errors="coerce")
# ASSERTION_START
assert (ms.notna().mean() >= 0.80)
ms_nonnull = ms.dropna()
if len(ms_nonnull) > 0:
    assert ((ms_nonnull >= 0) & (ms_nonnull <= 100)).all()
    assert np.isclose(ms_nonnull, np.round(ms_nonnull), atol=1e-8).all()
# ASSERTION_END

df["Meta_score_num"] = ms
# Use median to avoid skew when missing
meta_median = float(df["Meta_score_num"].median()) if not np.isnan(df["Meta_score_num"].median()) else 0.0
df["meta_norm"] = df["Meta_score_num"].fillna(meta_median) / 100.0

# Gross checks and parsing before popularity calculations
# ASSERTION_START
gross_present_ratio = df["Gross"].notna().mean()
assert gross_present_ratio >= 0.80
present_mask = df["Gross"].notna()
if present_mask.any():
    assert df.loc[present_mask, "Gross"].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"[0-9,]+").all()
# ASSERTION_END

df["Gross_num"] = df["Gross"].apply(parse_gross_to_int)
# ASSERTION_START
if df["Gross_num"].notna().any():
    assert (df.loc[df["Gross_num"].notna(), "Gross_num"] >= 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Compute normalized signals for ranking
votes = pd.to_numeric(df["No_of_Votes"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(float)
df["No_of_Votes"] = votes
log_votes = np.log1p(votes)
max_log_votes = float(log_votes.max()) if log_votes.max() > 0 else 1.0
df["votes_norm"] = log_votes / max_log_votes

# Poster link checks prior to asset wiring
# ASSERTION_START
pl = df["Poster_Link"].astype(str)
assert pl.str.startswith(("http://", "https://")).all()
assert pl.str.lower().str.endswith((".jpg", ".png")).all()
unique_ratio = pl.nunique() / len(pl)
assert unique_ratio >= 0.98
# ASSERTION_END

# Genre checks prior to age filtering
df["Genre_tokens"] = df["Genre"].apply(split_genres)
# ASSERTION_START
def _check_genre_tokens(tokens):
    if not isinstance(tokens, list):
        return False
    if not (1 <= len(tokens) <= 3):
        return False
    if len(tokens) != len(set(tokens)):
        return False
    return set(tokens).issubset(ALLOWED_GENRES)
assert df["Genre_tokens"].apply(_check_genre_tokens).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Certificate checks prior to age mapping
cert = df["Certificate"].astype("string")
# ASSERTION_START
assert (cert.notna().mean() >= 0.85)
non_null_cert = cert[cert.notna()]
if len(non_null_cert) > 0:
    assert (non_null_cert == non_null_cert.str.strip()).all()
    assert non_null_cert.isin(list(CERT_ALLOWED)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

def map_age_group(c):
    if pd.isna(c):
        return None
    s = str(c)
    if s in KIDS_CERTS:
        return "kids"
    if s in TEENS_CERTS:
        return "teens"
    if s in ADULTS_CERTS:
        return "adults"
    return None


df["age_group"] = cert.apply(map_age_group)

# Final quality relationships used as data health gates
# ASSERTION_START
pair = df[["IMDB_Rating", "Meta_score_num"]].dropna()
if len(pair) > 1:
    corr_rm = pair["IMDB_Rating"].corr(pair["Meta_score_num"]) or 0.0
    assert corr_rm >= 0.3
    high_rating = pair[pair["IMDB_Rating"] >= 8.5]
    if len(high_rating) > 0:
        assert float(high_rating["Meta_score_num"].mean()) >= 70.0
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
pair2 = df[["No_of_Votes", "Gross_num"]].dropna()
if len(pair2) > 1:
    corr_vg = pair2["No_of_Votes"].corr(pair2["Gross_num"]) or 0.0
    assert corr_vg >= 0.3
q90 = df["No_of_Votes"].quantile(0.9)
top_votes = df[df["No_of_Votes"] >= q90]
if len(top_votes) > 0:
    assert (top_votes["Gross"].notna().mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

# Build ranking signals
# Base score blends rating, votes, critics, and recency
df["base_score"] = 0.45 * df["rating_norm"] + 0.25 * df["votes_norm"] + 0.20 * df["meta_norm"] + 0.10 * df["recency_norm"]
# Critics choice emphasizes metascore
df["critics_score"] = 0.60 * df["meta_norm"] + 0.20 * df["rating_norm"] + 0.10 * df["votes_norm"] + 0.10 * df["recency_norm"]
# Trending emphasizes votes and recency
# Include a light gross component only if available
gross_norm = df["Gross_num"] / (df["Gross_num"].max() if pd.notna(df["Gross_num"].max()) and df["Gross_num"].max() > 0 else 1.0)
 gross_norm = gross_norm.fillna(0.0)
df["trending_score"] = 0.50 * df["votes_norm"] + 0.20 * df["recency_norm"] + 0.20 * df["rating_norm"] + 0.10 * gross_norm

# Prepare IDs
ids = df.apply(lambda r: f"{slugify(r['Series_Title'])}-{int(r['Released_Year'])}", axis=1)
df["content_id"] = ids

# Age-appropriate filters
kids_excluded = {"Horror", "Thriller"}

def filter_by_age_group(frame: pd.DataFrame, group: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    f = frame[frame["age_group"] == group].copy()
    if group == "kids":
        f = f[~f["Genre_tokens"].apply(lambda g: any(t in kids_excluded for t in g))]
        f = f[f["Runtime_min"] <= 150]
    return f


def to_items(frame: pd.DataFrame, score_col: str, limit: int = 20):
    cols = [
        "content_id", "Series_Title", "Released_Year", "Certificate", "Genre", "IMDB_Rating",
        "Meta_score_num", "No_of_Votes", "Poster_Link", "Runtime_min", score_col
    ]
    out = []
    for _, row in frame[cols].sort_values(score_col, ascending=False).head(limit).iterrows():
        out.append({
            "id": row["content_id"],
            "title": row["Series_Title"],
            "year": int(row["Released_Year"]),
            "certificate": None if pd.isna(row["Certificate"]) else str(row["Certificate"]),
            "genres": str(row["Genre"]),
            "rating": float(row["IMDB_Rating"]),
            "metascore": None if pd.isna(row["Meta_score_num"]) else int(row["Meta_score_num"]),
            "votes": int(row["No_of_Votes"]),
            "poster": str(row["Poster_Link"]),
            "runtime_minutes": int(row["Runtime_min"]),
            "score": round(float(row[score_col]), 6)
        })
    return out

carousels = []
for grp in ["kids", "teens", "adults"]:
    gdf = filter_by_age_group(df, grp)
    carousels.append({"group": grp, "carousel": "top_rated", "items": to_items(gdf, "base_score", 20)})
    carousels.append({"group": grp, "carousel": "critics_choice", "items": to_items(gdf.dropna(subset=["Meta_score_num"]), "critics_score", 20)})
    carousels.append({"group": grp, "carousel": "trending", "items": to_items(gdf, "trending_score", 20)})

output = {
    "generated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
    "input_rows": int(len(df)),
    "carousels": carousels
}

with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'carousels.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(output, f, ensure_ascii=False)

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import datetime

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", str(text).strip().lower()).strip("-")
    return s


def split_genres(genre_str: str):
    parts = [p.strip() for p in str(genre_str).split(",") if str(p).strip() != ""]
    return parts


def parse_gross_to_int(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return np.nan
    s = str(val).strip()
    s = s.replace(",", "")
    try:
        return int(s)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan


ALLOWED_GENRES = {
    "Action", "Adventure", "Animation", "Biography", "Comedy", "Crime", "Drama", "Family",
    "Fantasy", "History", "Horror", "Music", "Musical", "Mystery", "Romance", "Sci-Fi",
    "Sport", "Thriller", "War", "Western"
}

CERT_ALLOWED = {
    "G", "PG", "PG-13", "R", "NC-17", "U", "UA", "A", "12", "12A", "15", "18",
    "Not Rated", "Approved", "Passed", "TV-G", "TV-PG", "TV-14", "TV-MA"
}

KIDS_CERTS = {"G", "U", "PG", "TV-G"}
TEENS_CERTS = {"PG-13", "12", "12A", "UA", "TV-PG", "TV-14", "15", "Approved", "Passed"}
ADULTS_CERTS = {"R", "A", "NC-17", "18", "TV-MA", "Not Rated"}


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

# Pair uniqueness and title-year consistency before creating identifiers
# ASSERTION_START
pair_unique = ~df.duplicated(subset=["Series_Title", "Released_Year"])
assert pair_unique.all()
by_title = df.groupby("Series_Title")["Released_Year"].agg(["size", "nunique"]).reset_index(drop=True)
assert (by_title["size"] == by_title["nunique"]).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Released year assumptions before computing recency
# ASSERTION_START
years = pd.to_numeric(df["Released_Year"], errors="coerce")
assert years.notna().all()
assert years.between(1900, 2025).all()
year_str_4 = years.astype(int).astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")
assert year_str_4.all()
# ASSERTION_END

df["Released_Year"] = years.astype(int)
year_span = 2025 - 1900
recency_raw = (df["Released_Year"] - 1900) / year_span
df["recency_norm"] = recency_raw.clip(0, 1)

# Rating checks before scoring
# ASSERTION_START
ratings = pd.to_numeric(df["IMDB_Rating"], errors="coerce")
assert ratings.notna().all()
assert ratings.between(0.0, 10.0).all()
assert np.isclose(ratings * 10, np.round(ratings * 10), atol=1e-8).all()
assert (ratings >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.95
# ASSERTION_END

df["IMDB_Rating"] = ratings.astype(float)
df["rating_norm"] = df["IMDB_Rating"] / 10.0

# Runtime checks and parsing prior to using durations
rt_str = df["Runtime"].astype(str)
# ASSERTION_START
assert rt_str.str.fullmatch(r"\d+\s*min").all()
mins_check = rt_str.str.extract(r"(\d+)")[0].astype(int)
assert mins_check.between(45, 240).all()
assert (mins_check.between(80, 180).mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

df["Runtime_min"] = rt_str.str.extract(r"(\d+)")[0].astype(int)

# Meta_score checks and normalization prior to critic heavy ranking
ms = pd.to_numeric(df["Meta_score"], errors="coerce")
# ASSERTION_START
assert (ms.notna().mean() >= 0.80)
ms_nonnull = ms.dropna()
if len(ms_nonnull) > 0:
    assert ((ms_nonnull >= 0) & (ms_nonnull <= 100)).all()
    assert np.isclose(ms_nonnull, np.round(ms_nonnull), atol=1e-8).all()
# ASSERTION_END

df["Meta_score_num"] = ms
# Use median to avoid skew when missing
meta_median = float(df["Meta_score_num"].median()) if not np.isnan(df["Meta_score_num"].median()) else 0.0
df["meta_norm"] = df["Meta_score_num"].fillna(meta_median) / 100.0

# Gross checks and parsing before popularity calculations
# ASSERTION_START
gross_present_ratio = df["Gross"].notna().mean()
assert gross_present_ratio >= 0.80
present_mask = df["Gross"].notna()
if present_mask.any():
    assert df.loc[present_mask, "Gross"].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"[0-9,]+").all()
# ASSERTION_END

df["Gross_num"] = df["Gross"].apply(parse_gross_to_int)
# ASSERTION_START
if df["Gross_num"].notna().any():
    assert (df.loc[df["Gross_num"].notna(), "Gross_num"] >= 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Compute normalized signals for ranking
votes = pd.to_numeric(df["No_of_Votes"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(float)
df["No_of_Votes"] = votes
log_votes = np.log1p(votes)
max_log_votes = float(log_votes.max()) if log_votes.max() > 0 else 1.0
df["votes_norm"] = log_votes / max_log_votes

# Poster link checks prior to asset wiring
# ASSERTION_START
pl = df["Poster_Link"].astype(str)
assert pl.str.startswith(("http://", "https://")).all()
assert pl.str.lower().str.endswith((".jpg", ".png")).all()
unique_ratio = pl.nunique() / len(pl)
assert unique_ratio >= 0.98
# ASSERTION_END

# Genre checks prior to age filtering
df["Genre_tokens"] = df["Genre"].apply(split_genres)
# ASSERTION_START
def _check_genre_tokens(tokens):
    if not isinstance(tokens, list):
        return False
    if not (1 <= len(tokens) <= 3):
        return False
    if len(tokens) != len(set(tokens)):
        return False
    return set(tokens).issubset(ALLOWED_GENRES)
assert df["Genre_tokens"].apply(_check_genre_tokens).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Certificate checks prior to age mapping
cert = df["Certificate"].astype("string")
# ASSERTION_START
assert (cert.notna().mean() >= 0.85)
non_null_cert = cert[cert.notna()]
if len(non_null_cert) > 0:
    assert (non_null_cert == non_null_cert.str.strip()).all()
    assert non_null_cert.isin(list(CERT_ALLOWED)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

def map_age_group(c):
    if pd.isna(c):
        return None
    s = str(c)
    if s in KIDS_CERTS:
        return "kids"
    if s in TEENS_CERTS:
        return "teens"
    if s in ADULTS_CERTS:
        return "adults"
    return None


df["age_group"] = cert.apply(map_age_group)

# Final quality relationships used as data health gates
# ASSERTION_START
pair = df[["IMDB_Rating", "Meta_score_num"]].dropna()
if len(pair) > 1:
    corr_rm = pair["IMDB_Rating"].corr(pair["Meta_score_num"]) or 0.0
    assert corr_rm >= 0.3
    high_rating = pair[pair["IMDB_Rating"] >= 8.5]
    if len(high_rating) > 0:
        assert float(high_rating["Meta_score_num"].mean()) >= 70.0
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
pair2 = df[["No_of_Votes", "Gross_num"]].dropna()
if len(pair2) > 1:
    corr_vg = pair2["No_of_Votes"].corr(pair2["Gross_num"]) or 0.0
    assert corr_vg >= 0.3
q90 = df["No_of_Votes"].quantile(0.9)
top_votes = df[df["No_of_Votes"] >= q90]
if len(top_votes) > 0:
    assert (top_votes["Gross"].notna().mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

# Build ranking signals
# Base score blends rating, votes, critics, and recency
df["base_score"] = 0.45 * df["rating_norm"] + 0.25 * df["votes_norm"] + 0.20 * df["meta_norm"] + 0.10 * df["recency_norm"]
# Critics choice emphasizes metascore
df["critics_score"] = 0.60 * df["meta_norm"] + 0.20 * df["rating_norm"] + 0.10 * df["votes_norm"] + 0.10 * df["recency_norm"]
# Trending emphasizes votes and recency
# Include a light gross component only if available
gross_norm = df["Gross_num"] / (df["Gross_num"].max() if pd.notna(df["Gross_num"].max()) and df["Gross_num"].max() > 0 else 1.0)
 gross_norm = gross_norm.fillna(0.0)
df["trending_score"] = 0.50 * df["votes_norm"] + 0.20 * df["recency_norm"] + 0.20 * df["rating_norm"] + 0.10 * gross_norm

# Prepare IDs
ids = df.apply(lambda r: f"{slugify(r['Series_Title'])}-{int(r['Released_Year'])}", axis=1)
df["content_id"] = ids

# Age-appropriate filters
kids_excluded = {"Horror", "Thriller"}

def filter_by_age_group(frame: pd.DataFrame, group: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    f = frame[frame["age_group"] == group].copy()
    if group == "kids":
        f = f[~f["Genre_tokens"].apply(lambda g: any(t in kids_excluded for t in g))]
        f = f[f["Runtime_min"] <= 150]
    return f


def to_items(frame: pd.DataFrame, score_col: str, limit: int = 20):
    cols = [
        "content_id", "Series_Title", "Released_Year", "Certificate", "Genre", "IMDB_Rating",
        "Meta_score_num", "No_of_Votes", "Poster_Link", "Runtime_min", score_col
    ]
    out = []
    for _, row in frame[cols].sort_values(score_col, ascending=False).head(limit).iterrows():
        out.append({
            "id": row["content_id"],
            "title": row["Series_Title"],
            "year": int(row["Released_Year"]),
            "certificate": None if pd.isna(row["Certificate"]) else str(row["Certificate"]),
            "genres": str(row["Genre"]),
            "rating": float(row["IMDB_Rating"]),
            "metascore": None if pd.isna(row["Meta_score_num"]) else int(row["Meta_score_num"]),
            "votes": int(row["No_of_Votes"]),
            "poster": str(row["Poster_Link"]),
            "runtime_minutes": int(row["Runtime_min"]),
            "score": round(float(row[score_col]), 6)
        })
    return out

carousels = []
for grp in ["kids", "teens", "adults"]:
    gdf = filter_by_age_group(df, grp)
    carousels.append({"group": grp, "carousel": "top_rated", "items": to_items(gdf, "base_score", 20)})
    carousels.append({"group": grp, "carousel": "critics_choice", "items": to_items(gdf.dropna(subset=["Meta_score_num"]), "critics_score", 20)})
    carousels.append({"group": grp, "carousel": "trending", "items": to_items(gdf, "trending_score", 20)})

output = {
    "generated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
    "input_rows": int(len(df)),
    "carousels": carousels
}

with open(os.path.join(args.output, 'carousels.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(output, f, ensure_ascii=False)
